funds_data.description: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks to achieve its investment objectives through a combination of fixed income securities, Flexible Exchange Options (“FLEX Options”), and total return swaps. The fund invests in U.S. Treasury Bills, U.S. Treasury Notes, and the securities of U.S. government-sponsored entities (“GSEs”) (the “Fixed Income Strategy”), box spreads using FLEX Options (the “Box Spread Strategy”), and total return swaps (the “Total Return Swap Strategy”).
